decision: ACCEPT Peerit release sequence 21 as the LIVE bounded-public-test launch successor: a narrow binary content-type compatibility fix for the production pin-history bootstrap and the bounded runtime asset fetcher (accept BOTH application/octet-stream and binary/octet-stream for opaque binary artifacts, everything else unchanged), keeping the limited Cell-GET runtime authority EXPOSED at sequence 21 and signed seed recovery ENABLED for the same 34-record live launch seed. The exact production CSP remains unchanged, authenticated browser authority MUST become active before any relay I/O, recovery performs zero network PUTs, ordinary delivery remains LOCAL_ONLY, the all-five successor remains excluded, and the GA product gate remains blocked with all 22 blockers disclosed-open.

authority.owner_instruction: Live-site unblock: the deployed app at peerit.site boots to data-peerit-substrate-state=blocked-seed-recovery (lurker mode, no content). Root cause PROVEN end to end: the static host (Render, serving via its Cloudflare-backed edge) returns content-type binary/octet-stream for /peerit-production-pin-history-v1.cenc, while js/substrate/pin-history-bootstrap.mjs required exactly application/octet-stream -> PRODUCTION_PIN_HISTORY_CONTENT_TYPE_INVALID -> blocked pin-history -> blocked authority -> blocked seed recovery (verified via DOM probe + window.__peeritBlindSubstrateStatus in real Chromium). A render.yaml Content-Type override rule was tried (commit fc83bad, CI green, deployed 19:28Z) and had ZERO effect — Render's static host derives Content-Type from file extension and ignores header overrides; the cf-* headers are Render's own edge, no user Cloudflare zone is in the path, so the fix must be in the bundle. Release the patch as sequence 21 on the established ceremony, extending the MAX=20 ceremony cap to 21 (the cap is a constant in the ceremony scripts).
